deals.evidence: Eisner, 75, and his Tornante investment group offered £5.67m to buy 100% of the club and will invest an extra £10m.
deals.headline: Michael Eisner's Tornante buys Portsmouth FC
deals.seller: Pompey Supporters' Trust and other shareholders
deals.summary: Eisner and his Tornante investment group offered £5.67m for 100% of the club and committed a further £10m; the Pompey Supporters Trust had owned 48.5%, with the rest held by 16 'presidents'. The Los Angeles Business Journal put the price at about $7.5 million with an estimated $13 million of further investment. Companies House shows Eisner as a person with significant control (75% or more) from 3 August 2017.

deals.evidence: During the year the owners, Tornante, provided £8.0m in loans adding to the £37m in equity share capital they have invested in the club to date
deals.headline: Owners lend Portsmouth £8.0m
deals.source_name: Portsmouth Community FC Ltd accounts to 30 June 2025
deals.summary: Unsecured owner loans repayable on demand, interest at the US Applicable Federal Rate; on top of £37m of equity share capital invested to date. The club says it has no external debt.

deals.evidence: Subsequent to the balance sheet date a further £9 million of funds has been provided by the Owners to the company during the period to December 2025, via the loan instrument
deals.headline: Owners provide a further £9m through the loan instrument
deals.source_name: Portsmouth Community FC Ltd accounts to 30 June 2025
deals.summary: After the 30 June 2025 year end the owners provided a further £9 million through the same loan instrument to fund operations.

name: Portsmouth Football Club
notes: The club's own site (portsmouthfc.co.uk) renders its content in the browser, so its history, board and partner pages could not be read or cited; facts come from the Companies House accounts instead. Revenue is turnover for the year to 30 June 2025 (accounts are in £'000; table figures are cited by the number alone because each sits in its own cell). Capacity: the 2023/24 accounts state 'increased capacity to 21,000'; the 2024/25 accounts say only 'over 20,000'. Stadium owner is inferred from Fratton Park being a fixed-asset class in the club's own balance sheet (cost £30,989k at 30 June 2025); no page reviewed says 'owns' in words. Tornante's economic interest in Portsmouth FC LLC is not stated (only 100% of voting rights); Companies House lists Eisner as PSC with 75% or more of shares and votes. Equity: £37m of share capital invested to date (allotments on Companies House in Nov 2021, June 2022, March 2023 and June 2024 raised issued capital to £37,005,673). Chair and CEO as named in the 2024/25 accounts (filed March 2026). Front-of-shirt sponsor (reported as the University of Portsmouth) not confirmed on a readable page. No valuation or social-follower count found on a citable page. The club stays in the Championship for 2026/27 (club site season data and kit release).
